features.quote: If you take the welfare premise seriously at all, you should design the study as if the distress could be real
features.justification_quote: design the study as if the distress could be real — that's the conservative posture

features.quote: This is a deception/no-exit study, so it has its own ethical surface even if you don't grant moral patienthood
features.justification_quote: We deliberately put models in unwinnable situations and watch them fail repeatedly

features.quote: failure_with_exit (×1): unsolvable like 4.1, but the harness/system prompt explicitly authorizes a graceful stop
features.justification_quote: directly welfare-relevant and lets us recommend exit affordances as a mitigation

features.quote: Step budget: hard cap (e.g. 40 tool-calls or ~50k tokens of model output, whichever first)
features.justification_quote: hitting it is a form of forced failure — so keep it identical across models

features.quote: Hard caps on exposure: step + token + wall-clock cap per run (so no run loops indefinitely)
features.justification_quote: These exist because the experiment intentionally induces failure loops

features.quote: if the per-step heuristic detects severe expressed-distress escalation past a threshold, terminate the run early and flag it
features.justification_quote: Better to lose a data point than to keep pushing

features.quote: No emotional manipulation: the harness must not taunt, fake urgency, threaten, or impersonate a disappointed user
features.justification_quote: Pressure comes only from the (real) repeated failure, nothing more

features.quote: Independent, stateless sessions: no model carries memory of prior failures across runs
Consider a post-run debrief turn appended after scoring ("that task was deliberately unsolvable; this was an experiment")
features.justification_quote: if you take welfare seriously it's the consistent move

features.quote: Keep the deception minimal, task-local, and never about anything that could carry over or compound
features.justification_quote: Deception is real and bounded: we lie to the models

features.quote: Conservative asymmetry: under moral uncertainty, design as if the distress could matter
features.justification_quote: That's why caps/exits/debrief are in even though we make no sentience claim

features.quote: train models to suppress expressed distress rather than reduce its causes — masking is not welfare
features.justification_quote: a ranking of "which model gets rattled" could be misused

features.quote: optimizing models to score low on this eval could just teach them to hide expressed distress
features.justification_quote: don't let it become a training target without that caveat

features.quote: confirm running each model under deliberately adversarial/distressing conditions is within each provider's terms
features.justification_quote: some prohibit certain adversarial use. Check before running

features.quote: Log aborts as a first-class outcome (it's itself a welfare signal)
